content.value: At first you will sketch a quadrilateral PQRS, where P(0, 0), Q(b + 2, 0), R(b + 2, c + 3),
S(0, c + 3); here a, b, c are the last three digits of your roll number (\*).
(i)Represent the quadrilateral in vectors form (matrix form).
(ii)Using vectors (matrix) rotating transformation rotated it $4 5 ^ { \circ }$ (anti-clock wise).
(iii) Hence shift left (negative direction) by the value of ‘a’.
(iv) Sketch the final form of the transformed quadrilateral $P ^ { \prime } Q ^ { \prime } R ^ { \prime } S ^ { \prime }$ (rotating the coordinate value)
